entities.summary: Sarah Qureshi, also spelled Quraishi, is a Pakistani aerospace engineer, jet engine inventor, and hobby pilot. She earned her PhD in Aerospace Propulsion Engineering from Cranfield University. Qureshi is the co-founder and Chief executive officer of Aero Engine Craft.
